plan.notes: Source: Seattle University official four-year degree plan page for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, College of Science & Engineering: https://seattleu.edu/academics/all-programs/computer-science-ba-bs/computer-science-bs-four-year-plan/ (Quarter-Based Degree Plan, for students who enroll prior to Summer 2027). Catalog year: 2026-2027 (current quarter-based plan as of 2026-09-30; Seattle U is a quarter school transitioning to semesters in Summer 2027 - the semester-based plan for Summer 2027+ entrants was NOT used). Transcription: manual term-by-term transcription of the official sample-plan tables; credits are QUARTER credits. The page states this is a sample, not the only way to complete the plan, and that the course order accounts for prerequisites. Course prerequisites cross-checked against official catalog.seattleu.edu course descriptions: CPSC 1430 requires B- or better in CPSC 1420; CPSC 2430/2500 require B- or better in CPSC 1430; CPSC 3200/3300/3500 require B- or better in CPSC 2430; CPSC 3400/4100 require B- or better in CPSC 2430 plus CPSC 2600 or MATH 3000; CPSC 4800 requires UCOR 1100 and B- or better in CPSC 2430 plus chair permission (taken concurrently with CPSC 4870); CPSC 4880 requires CPSC 4800 and CPSC 4870; CPSC 4890 requires CPSC 4880; MATH 2310 requires MATH 1335 (C- or better); MATH 2320 requires MATH 1336 (C- or better); CPSC 1420 requires MATH 1021 or higher (C- or better). MATH 1021 is listed in external_prereqs as a placement-level floor for CPSC 1420; UCOR 1100 (Academic Writing Seminar) is listed in external_prereqs because the catalog requires it before CPSC 4800 - it may be satisfied by one of the UCOR Module I choice slots in Year 1. Senior capstone (CPSC 4870/4880/4890) entry per catalog: 120 credits completed, two completed 3000-level CPSC courses plus one additional 3000/4000-level CPSC course with C or better, major GPA in good standing. Duplicate-looking codes (UCOR 1XXX/2XXX/3XXX, CPSC 4XXX, SCI-ELECTIVE, GEN-ELECTIVE) are intentional student-choice slots; the sample plan lists them identically each term. Grade rules: C (2.00) required in all CPSC courses used for the major; 2.0 minimum major and cumulative GPA. Degree minimums per page: 180 quarter credits to graduate; 122 quarter credits in the major.
